```{r}
# ==========================================
# Method 3: Grouped jackknife variance for linear logistic regression (REAL DATA)
# Model: same as Method 1 (linear MVPA + rich covariate set)
# Inference: grouped delete-one-group jackknife SE for MVPA slope (beta_mvpa)
# ==========================================

source("shared_setup.R")
dat <- make_analysis_dataset("wave1.csv", "wave4.csv")

# ---- Base parametric model (same as Method 1) ----
fit0 <- glm(
  obese ~ mvpa +
    female +
    age_w1 +
    race_eth +
    income_w1 +
    parent_educ_w1 +
    bmi_w1,
  data = dat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

beta_full <- coef(fit0)[["mvpa"]]

# ---- Grouped jackknife ----
set.seed(123)
G <- 50  # use 50 unless you have a strong reason; this is what your paper described
n <- nrow(dat)

# Assign approximately equal-sized groups
groups <- sample(rep(seq_len(G), length.out = n))

beta_g <- numeric(G)

for (g in seq_len(G)) {
  d_minus <- dat[groups != g, , drop = FALSE]
  fg <- glm(
    obese ~ mvpa +
      female +
      age_w1 +
      race_eth +
      income_w1 +
      parent_educ_w1 +
      bmi_w1,
    data = d_minus,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  beta_g[g] <- coef(fg)[["mvpa"]]
}

# Delete-one-group jackknife variance
beta_bar <- mean(beta_g)
var_jk <- ((G - 1) / G) * sum((beta_g - beta_bar)^2)
se_jk <- sqrt(var_jk)

# Wald-type CI using jackknife SE
z <- qnorm(0.975)
ci_beta <- beta_full + c(-1, 1) * z * se_jk
or_full <- exp(beta_full)
or_ci <- exp(ci_beta)

cat("Method 3 (Jackknife): MVPA log-odds slope (full) =", round(beta_full, 6), "\n")
cat("Grouped jackknife SE =", round(se_jk, 6), "\n")
cat("95% CI for beta:", round(ci_beta[1], 6), round(ci_beta[2], 6), "\n")
cat("Odds ratio exp(beta) =", round(or_full, 6), "\n")
cat("95% CI for OR:", round(or_ci[1], 6), round(or_ci[2], 6), "\n")

saveRDS(
  list(
    model = fit0,
    beta_full = beta_full,
    beta_reps = beta_g,
    se_jk = se_jk,
    ci_beta = ci_beta,
    or = or_full,
    ci_or = or_ci,
    G = G,
    groups = groups
  ),
  "method3_jackknife_results.rds"
)

```
